parts:
Here's some code that might help

This first bit is a reactive expression for the server side that randomly chooses a sub directory when the user clicks an action button. The directories are named with different years (2009 to 2013), different month-day values, and an ID number (OUID). The expression picks a folder, extracts the ID and month-day value, and then outputs this stuff and the file name as a list. Perhaps you could modify this so that it uses an input widget to designate a folder among those available instead of just setting the random seed. You can call this expression in anything you want to update when the user picks a file. 

  newdeal <- reactive({
    set.seed(input$action)
    order <- sample(2009:2013, 5, replace = F)
    thefolder <- sample(1:length(allfolders),1)
    thefolder <- allfolders[thefolder]
    OUID <- substr(thefolder, 1, 3)
    moday <- substr(thefolder, 9, 12)
         newstuff <- list(OUID, moday, thefolder)
    return(newstuff) 
  }).
